documented_mathematical_contract: First bar undefined. Second-bar direction depends on rising close; equality chooses downward. Seed SAR from previous opposite extreme, EP from current directional extreme, acceleration0.02.
Advance SAR toward EP, then test strict current-range penetration. A reversal switches direction, selects current/previous extreme, and resets EP and acceleration.
Initial and reversal bars skip acceleration increments. Other strict new extremes update EP and add0.02 capped0.2.
Finally clamp using preceding one/two opposite extremes. Calculate continuously from a fixed origin; warmup does not restart state.

independent_math_expression.implementation: Fresh scalar float64 state-transition expression for synthetic comparison; no published code pasted and no implementation added to repository.
independent_math_expression.arithmetic_order: SAR plus acceleration times EP-minus-SAR; update/reversal before prior-extreme clamp; strict greater-than and less-than, without epsilon.

fixture_definition.open: previous close; first open equals first close, except explicit wick-conflict override
fixture_definition.high_low: max(open,close)+0.8 and min(open,close)-0.6, except zero-range and explicit overrides
fixture_definition.gapped_close: oscillating plus20 from index200, minus30 from index400
fixture_definition.equal_first_close: oscillating fixture with close1=close0 and its high/low extended if needed
fixture_definition.signal_comparison: strict close>SAR and close<SAR, separately; undefined reference value suppresses comparisons
